articles.title: Ganesh Chaturthi Date 2026 Shubh Muhurat: When you should bring and do Ganpati Sthapana this year
articles.description: In 2026, Ganesh Chaturthi is set for September 14, a day dedicated to the installation of idols of Lord Ganesha. The sacred Puja Muhurat for conducting the installation and prayers occurs at midday. Festivities involve prayer rituals, aarti, and offerings, with modak being a favorite delicacy. The vibrant 10-day Ganeshotsav culminates with Ganesh Visarjan on September 25, celebrating the beloved deity associated with wisdom and new beginnings.

articles.title: China Erupts After Taiwan VP Visits NATO Nation Italy | Watch
articles.description: Taiwanese Vice President Hsiao Bi-khim’s rare visit to NATO member Italy has triggered a sharp backlash from Beijing. China condemned the trip as “despicable” and said it had lodged “solemn representations” with Italy and the EU, highlighting the growing tensions over Taiwan and its expanding ties with Europe.

articles.title: Pezeshkian thanks PM Modi for strengthening BRICS, says Iran under ‘critical, dangerous’ pressure from US and Israel

articles.title: Why President’s former ADC Rishabh Singh Sambyal never got married: ‘That’s the biggest sacrifice’
articles.description: Rishabh Singh Sambyal dedicated many years as Aide-de-Camp to President Droupadi Murmu, a role that demanded immense sacrifice, including postponing his personal life and marriage. This solitude turned into a period of self-discovery and introspection. Surprisingly, he did not anticipate taking on such a significant military duty. After twelve years of service, Sambyal now stands at the crossroads of his life, contemplating how to embark on a new chapter.

articles.title: Delhi’s Student Housing Crisis: Unsafe PGs, Broken System? The Satya Niketan Wake-Up Call | Prasang
articles.description: In Episode 03 of Prasang, TOI’s Prasad Sanyal and Prabhash Jha delve deeper into the key questions surrounding Delhi’s Satya Niketan building collapse that claimed the lives of seven people. Who was responsible, why do unauthorised constructions continue despite civic rules, and why does enforcement often begin only after tragedy strikes? They examine the precarious conditions of PG accommodations in the national capital, the shortage of student housing and the systemic lapses that leave thousands vulnerable. The discussion also looks at earlier incidents, accountability, corruption and the enforcement of building laws.
